senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be rough, excited,] to be angry.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:8">Esth. R. to I, 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01834"><he>קִצָּפוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 38:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVIII</cite> <he>אנו … ואתה קוֹצֵף</he> we sin, and thou art angry.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1053:29">Yalk. Esth. 1053</cite> <he>קָצְפוּ ואמרו וכ׳</he> they grew excited and said &c.; a. fr.

R. s. 88</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:13">Esth. R. to II, 21</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 146:6">Yalk. Gen. 146</cite> <he>מַקְצִיף</he>; a. e.
